zh.serverSettings.title: 服务器设置
zh.serverSettings.connection.title: 连接信息
zh.serverSettings.field.name: 名称
zh.serverSettings.connection.hintLocal: 本机服务器由面板直接托管 Agent 进程，不需要 SSH；只在服务器列表与页头对地址做脱敏展示。
zh.serverSettings.connection.hintRemote: SSH 与回连地址用于安装/重装 Agent；只在服务器列表与页头对地址做脱敏展示。
zh.serverSettings.agent.descLocal: 本机 Agent：由面板直接托管进程（专用目录，无需 SSH / systemd）
zh.serverSettings.agent.descRemote: 通过 SSH 部署到远端（默认 /opt/blocknexus-agent，systemd 托管）
zh.serverSettings.agent.localRunning: 本机 Agent 进程运行中（pid {0}）。停止只结束进程，实例与存档保留。
zh.serverSettings.agent.localStopped: 本机 Agent 未运行。启动后面板会自动连上（实例与存档均保留）。
zh.serverSettings.agent.onlineHint: Agent 在线。修改过 SSH 信息或迁移机器后可在此重装。
zh.serverSettings.agent.offlineHint: Agent 离线：点击「安装 Agent」通过 SSH 自动部署，或使用「手动安装」拿到命令。
zh.serverSettings.sys.title: 系统信息
zh.serverSettings.sys.waiting: 等待 Agent 上线后自动获取。
zh.serverSettings.agentUpdate.toast.started: 结果会通过实时通知反馈
zh.serverSettings.danger.title: 删除服务器
zh.serverSettings.danger.desc: 仅从面板移除该服务器及其记录，远端 Agent 与 MC 实例不受影响（可手动卸载）。
zh.serverSettings.delete.title: 删除服务器「{0}」？
zh.serverSettings.delete.descLocal: 仅从面板移除，本机 Agent 进程与实例目录不受影响（可在 Agent 卡停止或卸载）。
zh.serverSettings.delete.descRemote: 仅从面板移除，远程 Agent 与实例不受影响（可手动卸载）。
zh.serverSettings.toast.installEndedDetail: Agent 未按时回连，请检查面板地址/防火墙
zh.serverSettings.toast.localStarting: 本机 Agent 正在启动
zh.serverSettings.toast.localStopping: 本机 Agent 正在停止
zh.serverSettings.java.title: Java 环境
zh.serverSettings.java.switching: 正在切换默认 Java 到 {0}…
zh.serverSettings.java.switched: 默认 Java 已切换到 {0}
zh.serverSettings.java.notInstalled: 未安装（新版 MC 需 Java 21+，旧版 MC 需 8–17）
zh.serverSettings.java.listNeedsAgent: 版本列表需要更新的 Agent 支持——远端 v{0} 将自动更新到 v{1}
zh.serverSettings.java.emptyHint: 服务器上没有发现可用的 Java——选择版本点「安装」，会下载 Temurin JRE 到 /opt/blocknexus-java 并设为默认；各版本独立目录，可随时切换或卸载。
zh.serverSettings.java.uninstallDescActive: 这是当前默认版本，卸载时会自动切换到其余版本或系统 Java。该操作不可恢复。
zh.serverSettings.java.uninstallDesc: 将永久删除该版本的安装目录。该操作不可恢复。

en.serverSettings.title: Server Settings
en.serverSettings.connection.title: Connection
en.serverSettings.field.name: Name
en.serverSettings.connection.hintLocal: For local servers the panel hosts the Agent process directly — no SSH needed; the address is masked in the server list and page header.
en.serverSettings.connection.hintRemote: SSH and the callback URL are used to install/reinstall the Agent; the address is masked in the server list and page header.
en.serverSettings.agent.descLocal: Local Agent: the panel hosts the process directly (dedicated directory, no SSH / systemd)
en.serverSettings.agent.descRemote: Deployed to the remote host over SSH (default /opt/blocknexus-agent, managed by systemd)
en.serverSettings.agent.localRunning: Local Agent process is running (pid {0}). Stopping only ends the process; instances and saves are kept.
en.serverSettings.agent.localStopped: Local Agent is not running. Once started, the panel connects automatically (instances and saves are kept).
en.serverSettings.agent.onlineHint: Agent is online. Reinstall here after changing SSH credentials or migrating the machine.
en.serverSettings.agent.offlineHint: Agent is offline: click "Install Agent" to deploy automatically over SSH, or use "Manual install" to get the command.
en.serverSettings.sys.title: System Info
en.serverSettings.sys.noData: No data while the Agent is offline
en.serverSettings.sys.waiting: Collected automatically once the Agent is online.
en.serverSettings.agentUpdate.toast.started: The result will be reported via live notifications
en.serverSettings.danger.title: Delete server
en.serverSettings.danger.desc: Removes the server and its records from the panel only; the remote Agent and MC instances are unaffected (you can uninstall manually).
en.serverSettings.delete.title: Delete server "{0}"?
en.serverSettings.delete.descLocal: Removes it from the panel only; the local Agent process and instances directory are unaffected (stop or uninstall from the Agent card).
en.serverSettings.delete.descRemote: Removes it from the panel only; the remote Agent and instances are unaffected (you can uninstall manually).
en.serverSettings.toast.installEndedDetail: The Agent did not connect back in time. Check the panel address and firewall.
en.serverSettings.java.title: Java Environment
en.serverSettings.java.toast.busy: A Java installation is already in progress
en.serverSettings.java.notInstalled: Not installed (new MC needs Java 21+, legacy MC needs 8–17)
en.serverSettings.java.listNeedsAgent: The version list needs a newer Agent — remote v{0} will auto-update to v{1}
en.serverSettings.java.emptyHint: No usable Java found on the server — pick a version and click "Install" to download Temurin JRE into /opt/blocknexus-java and set it as the default; each version lives in its own directory and can be switched or uninstalled anytime.
en.serverSettings.java.uninstallDescActive: This is the current default version; uninstalling will automatically switch to another version or the system Java. This action cannot be undone.
en.serverSettings.java.uninstallDesc: The installation directory of this version will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.
